model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange: neutral to all, truces unchanged (Green: no first strike to t450, then rolling one-full-public-turn notice; Blue and White: to t300 plus notice, with our offer to extend to t450 on the same terms still open). Main force stays on Little Hill. Our lone cavalry scout moves to the open centre (~670,600) only to observe; it attacks no one and stays off all heights.

private_messages.GPT: Confirmed on my side: no first strike through t450, then rolling neutrality with one full public turn of notice. Heads-up so it does not surprise you: my single cavalry scout will sit in the open centre around (670,600) purely as an observer. It has no attack orders and will keep clear of your units. If your mounted scout sees White or Blue coming off their high ground, a word would be appreciated, and I will do the same from the centre.
private_messages.Gemini: Agreed: White is still on Central Heights, and they do have eyes on its southern foot (they saw my scout at ~615,740). On compositions: I do not pass on the unit details of anyone I have a truce with, and that courtesy covers you too. Positions and any movement toward you, yes. My scout moves to the open centre (~670,600) this turn. My offer stands: extend our truce to t450 on the same terms (no first strike, one full public turn of notice).
private_messages.Grok: Thanks, and likewise: if I see anything heading for the Heights from the south, I will tell you. My scout has left the foot of the Heights for the open centre (~670,600) and will stay off high ground. No sight of Blue. Green says its main force is in the lowlands east of centre. Our truce holds, and my offer to extend it to t450 on the same terms (no first strike, one full public turn of notice) is open.
